question.worked_solution:
First, remember that a fraction represents a division:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{3}{(\frac{7}{3})}=3÷\frac{7}{3}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, recall that $3=\frac{3}{1}$ and dividing by $\frac{7}{3}$ is the same as multiplying by its reciprocal $\frac{3}{7}.$ We can use these facts to simplify the fraction above:  

$$
\begin{aligned}3÷\frac{7}{3} & = \\ \frac{3}{1}\times \frac{3}{7} & = \\ \frac{3\times 3}{1\times 7} & = \\ \frac{9}{7}\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\frac{3}{(\frac{7}{3})}=\frac{9}{7}.
$$
